organism.common_name: Post-glacial Pitx1-deleted freshwater benthic stickleback (low plate)

phenomenon_scale.note: Cellular-tier critical wavelength. Distinct from the 2.2 mm organ-scale benthic bar and the 2.4 mm marine organ-scale bar.

same_chronospecies_organ_tier.note: Sibling organ-scale model. Parameters are not reused here.

pde: du/dt = Du * laplacian(u) + gamma * (a - u + u^2 v)
dv/dt = Dv * laplacian(v) + gamma * (b - u^2 v)
equations.jacobian: fu = gamma*(-1 + 2*u0*v0), fv = gamma*u0^2, gu = gamma*(-2*u0*v0), gv = gamma*(-u0^2)
equations.dispersion: det(J - k^2 D) = Du*Dv*k^4 - (Dv*fu + Du*gv)*k^2 + (fu*gv - fv*gu)
equations.boundary_conditions: Periodic on a square dermal patch of a few cellular wavelengths. The rendered ocellus is recentered on the activator maximum.
equations.readout: Plate luminance L(r) = c0 + c1*U(r)*Vig(r) + c2*Vfield(r)*Vig(r), with Vig a fixed weak illumination envelope. c0, c1, c2 are fit once to the azimuthal mean of the detail plate.

parameters.note: Grid spacing dx is set so the linear lambda_c equals 4.315e-5 m. These rates are not the 2.2 mm organ-scale sibling's parameters.

empirical_claims: Colosimo et al. 2005: low-plate freshwater sticklebacks repeatedly fix Eda alleles; marine fish keep a complete plate row.
Chan et al. 2010: pelvic reduction in benthic freshwater populations is caused by recurrent deletion of a Pitx1 enhancer. Age of the post-glacial morph is Holocene (0 Ma on this chronoseries).
Miller et al. 2007: Kit-ligand cis-regulatory changes alter stickleback pigmentation.
Greenwood, Jones, Chan et al. 2011: divergent juvenile pigment patterns in threespine sticklebacks have a mapped genetic basis.
Turing 1952 and Schnakenberg 1979 supply k_c. Kondo and Asai 1995 and Nakamasu et al. 2009 supply the chromatophore activator-inhibitor interpretation from other teleosts.

reported_in_source: Plate-armor and pelvic-spine reduction in post-glacial benthic sticklebacks (Colosimo 2005; Chan 2010).
Genetic control of juvenile stickleback pigment pattern (Greenwood et al. 2011) and Kit ligand (Miller et al. 2007).
Reaction-diffusion wavelength selection (Turing 1952; Schnakenberg 1979) and teleost chromatophore Turing patterns (Kondo and Asai 1995; Nakamasu et al. 2009).
reconstructed_in_script: Schnakenberg integration on a 32^2 periodic patch with Du=0.55, Dv=12, gamma=0.3, a=0.1, b=0.9, seed 3234.
dx chosen so the linear critical wavelength is 43.15 µm (4.315e-5 m).
Azimuthal luminance of the canonical detail plate fit by a two-morphogen linear readout.
transfer_boundary: Nakamasu zebrafish and Kondo angelfish rate constants are not stickleback measurements. Only the activator-inhibitor sign pattern is transferred.
The 43 µm figure is the catalog detail-tier assignment for this slot, not a published melanophore spacing counted on benthic G. aculeatus.
does_not_claim: Does not claim the Commons lateral photograph is a benthic low-plate individual.
Does not claim the gallery detail plate is a raw micrograph of a 43 µm lattice; it is the repository canonical single-focus field (100 µm bar) used as the shape target.
Does not claim the organ-scale 2.2 mm benthic bar model (slot 1211) or the marine 2.4 mm model.

detail_plate.role: Canonical detail-scale comparison plate (100 µm scale bar, 111 px).
